A metric to determine the applications long-term viability is critical in gauging 
whether it would have an impact on student learning habits. This metric would 
evaluate the students’ willingness to continue using the application beyond the 
allocated studying hours, and the students’ desire to return after an extended 
period of time. 
The selected metrics embody ideologies of self-regulated learning and cognitive 
load theorems, and tie into the applications primary feature set using gamified 
and microlearning techniques. These metrics aim to provide a holistic view and 
guide the researcher to better understand the effectiveness of the employed 
techniques.
